Expand global user config: broaden allowlist + model chains + preset references

source.description:
PROBLEM: When the global user.json overlay sets execution.fallback_models = ["a","b"], the merged spec still retains spec.specialist.execution.fallback_model = "<package legacy value>" from the package canonical layer. Plural override should clear (or override semantics on) the legacy singular field. Runtime chain walk in src/specialist/runner.ts may pick the wrong model when both fields coexist.

SUCCESS: The loader merge clears spec.specialist.execution.fallback_model when a higher-priority layer sets execution.fallback_models. resolveModelChain returns only the plural chain, not legacy + plural mixed.

SCRUTINY: medium (model resolution path; wrong-model dispatch on first-attempt failure is observable to operator).

SCOPE: src/specialist/loader.ts merge path. Possibly src/specialist/model-chain.ts if the resolver is the right home for the precedence rule.

NON_GOALS: do not add new schema fields. Do not change run-time chain walk semantics.

CONSTRAINTS: legacy singular still works when only it is set. Plural takes precedence when both layers contribute.

VALIDATION: flip the it.skip on tests/unit/specialist/loader.test.ts:698 ("global plural fallback_models wins over package singular fallback_model") to it; case must pass. Run bun --bun vitest run tests/unit/specialist/loader.test.ts.

OUTPUT: merge fix + green test + bd close referencing unitAI-gp7nq.9 and this bead.

DISCOVERED FROM: unitAI-gp7nq.9 test-engineer chain (job b821af).
